Alfie Jones.note: Jones stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Alfie Jones.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ali Ahmed.note: Ahmed's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Ali Ahmed.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Alistair Johnston.note: Johnston is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Alistair Johnston.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alphonso Davies.note: Watch Davies for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Alphonso Davies.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Cyle Larin.note: Watch Larin for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cyle Larin.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Dayne St. Clair.note: Clair's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Dayne St. Clair.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Derek Cornelius.note: Watch Cornelius for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Derek Cornelius.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ismael Kone.note: Koné stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ismael Kone.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Jacob Shaffelburg.note: Watch Shaffelburg for explosive speed once open grass appears. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Jacob Shaffelburg.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Joel Waterman.note: Watch Waterman for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Joel Waterman.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Jonathan David.note: David is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Jonathan David.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Jonathan Osorio.note: Osorio's signature is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Jonathan Osorio.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Liam Millar.note: Millar's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Liam Millar.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Luc De Fougerolles.note: Fougerolles stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Luc De Fougerolles.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Marcelo Flores.note: Flores stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Marcelo Flores.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Mathieu Choiniere.note: Watch Choinière for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mathieu Choiniere.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Maxime Crepeau.note: Crépeau's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Maxime Crepeau.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Moise Bombito.note: Bombito stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Moise Bombito.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Nathan Saliba.note: Watch Saliba for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Nathan Saliba.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Niko Sigur.note: Watch Sigur for creating a better angle for the next pass. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Niko Sigur.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Owen Goodman.note: Goodman is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Owen Goodman.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Promise David.note: David's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Promise David.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Richie Laryea.note: Laryea's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Richie Laryea.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Stephen Eustaquio.club: Los Angeles FC (on loan from Porto)
Stephen Eustaquio.note: Eustáquio stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Stephen Eustaquio.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Tajon Buchanan.note: Buchanan's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Tajon Buchanan.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Tani Oluwaseyi.note: Oluwaseyi's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Tani Oluwaseyi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。
